      "soft_objectives": ["minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance (s-pol, normal incidence, 450-700 nm)", "achieve mean reflectance < 0.03"],
      "manufacturing_considerations": ["Preferred fabrication range 40-160 nm, but search expanded to 20-200 nm to ensure mathematical feasibility finding; final selection should prioritize solutions within 40-160 nm if performance is comparable."],
      "evidence_ids": [],
      "theory_basis": ["Fresnel equations for normal incidence", "Transfer Matrix Method for multilayer interference", "Impedance matching theory for double-layer AR coatings"],

      "known_risks": ["Optimal solution might lie outside the preferred 40-160 nm manufacturing range", "Coarse grid might miss very sharp minima if step size is too large relative to budget"],
      "execution_request_english": "Execute a deterministic optimization for a planar stack: Air | TiO2 (n=2.40) | SiO2 (n=1.46) | Glass (n=1.52). Variables: thickness of TiO2 and SiO2. Constraints: Both thicknesses must be between 20 nm and 200 nm. Objective: Minimize arithmetic mean power reflectance for s-polarized light at 0 degrees incidence over 450-700 nm (5 nm steps). Method: Initialize with a uniform grid of 8x8 points (64 evaluations) covering the [20, 200] nm range for both layers. Evaluate all 64 points using TMM. Select the best performing point as the final result. Do not perform iterative refinement beyond this single grid pass due to the 64-evaluation limit. Report the thicknesses and the full reflectance spectrum of the best candidate. Seed: 17.",
      "priority": 1,
      "parent_route_id": "route_01",
      "revision_reason": "Route_01 failed with 0 valid candidates due to potential constraint conflict in the [40, 160] nm range during initialization. This route expands bounds to [20, 200] nm and uses a strict grid-search initialization to guarantee valid evaluations and cover the design space deterministically within the 64-evaluation budget.",
      "expected_observations": [
        "valid_candidates should be exactly 64 (all grid points satisfy the relaxed 20-200 nm bounds)",
        "best_target_score should correspond to the minimum mean reflectance found on the 8x8 grid",
        "If the hypothesis is false (bounds were not the issue), best_target_score will remain poor (>0.05) despite full grid coverage, suggesting the material pair or topology is insufficient for the target."
      ],
      "stop_conditions": [
        "If valid_candidates < 64, judge constraint definition error -> stop and report specific constraint violation logic.",
        "If best_target_score > 0.10 across the entire grid, judge the two-layer topology with these materials as physically incapable of meeting the soft target -> stop and recommend topology change (e.g., 3 layers) in a future request.",
        "After completing the 64 evaluations, stop naturally as the budget is exhausted; retain the best candidate found."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "research_influence": [
    "Feedback directive explicitly identified 'search_progress' failure and suggested relaxing thickness bounds from [40, 160] to [20, 200] nm to resolve initialization emptiness.",
    "Insight appendage confirmed no unexplained regressions, pointing to constraint/initialization logic as the sole failure mode."
  ],
  "unresolved_decisions": [
    "Whether the global optimum lies strictly within the original 40-160 nm manufacturing preference or requires the extended 20-200 nm range.",
    "Whether a TiO2-first or SiO2-first ordering is superior (this route tests TiO2-first based on standard high-index-substrate matching; SiO2-first remains an alternative if this fails)."
  ],
  "stop_if_all_routes_fail": "If the expanded bound grid search yields no candidate with mean reflectance below 0.05, conclude that the two-layer SiO2/TiO2 system on glass cannot achieve the desired broadband AR performance under normal incidence, necessitating a change in material set or layer count."
}
